sentence_1_it: Tom ha trovato la sedia abbastanza comoda.
sentence_1_en: Tom found the chair quite comfortable.

sentence_1_it: Tom tentò di mettersi comodo, ma Mary lo spinse via.
sentence_1_en: Tom attempted to snuggle, but Mary pushed him away.

sentence_2_it: I jihadisti sono in grado di decapitare i civili, uccidere i bambini e violentare le donne indifese, ma quando si tratta di combattere una forza militare non vogliono saperne a che fare e tornano qui nelle loro comode case con la coda fra le gambe.
sentence_2_en: Jihadis are capable of beheading civilians, murdering children and raping defenceless women, but when it comes to fighting a military force they don't want to know, and they come back here to their comfortable homes with their tails between their legs.
